jobs.title: Data Center Technician
jobs.description:
Overview
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Responsibilities

• Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.

• Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).

• Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.

• Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.

• Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.

• Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.

• Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data center facilities.

• Embodies our culture and values .

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications

Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
 Background Check Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

• Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications :

• Some experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

• Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

• A driving licence would be beneficial

Data Center Technicians ATR-B - The typical base pay range for this role across Switzerland is CHF 81,500.00 - CHF 97,700.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/switzerland-corporate-pay.html

Data Center Technicians ATR-C - The typical base pay range for this role across Switzerland is CHF 81,500.00 - CHF 97,700.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Questa opportunità vi permetterà di sviluppare una comprensione del nostro ambiente Data Center, familiarizzare con le procedure di sicurezza e gestione dei dati e accelerare la crescita della vostra carriera nel processo. Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) è il motore che alimenta i nostri servizi cloud. Come CO+I DCT, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella fornitura dell'infrastruttura e delle tecnologie fondamentali per i servizi online di Microsoft, tra cui Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive e la piattaforma Microsoft Azure. Come gruppo, CO+I si concentra sullo sviluppo personale e professionale di tutti i dipendenti e offre opportunità di formazione e crescita, tra cui Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion Trainings ed eventi, e certificazioni professionali. La nostra fondazione è costruita e gestita da un team di esperti di materia che lavorano per supportare i servizi per oltre 1 miliardo di clienti e 20 milioni di imprese in oltre 90 paesi in tutto il mondo. Con la sostenibilità ambientale e l'ottimizzazione all'avanguardia del nostro data center, continuiamo a crescere ed evolvere, soddisfando le esigenze aziendali in continua evoluzione che tengono Microsoft come provider cloud di livello mondiale. • Contribuisce a un ambiente di team positivo ed efficace condividendo le informazioni con gli altri, contribuendo a riunioni di team regolari, facendo domande e rimanendo informati sullo stato del lavoro degli altri.

Als Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) entwickeln Sie ein Verständnis für Standardprozesse und -verfahren zur Vorbereitung, Installation, Diagnose, Fehlersuche, Austausch und / oder Stilllegung von Geräten unter der Anleitung erfahrenerer Data Center-Kollegen. Diese Gelegenheit ermöglicht es Ihnen, ein Verständnis für unsere Data Center-Umgebung zu entwickeln, sich mit Sicherheits- und Datenmanagementverfahren vertraut zu machen und dabei Ihr berufliches Wachstum zu beschleunigen. Microsofts Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) ist die Engine, die unsere Cloud-Services antreibt. Als CO+I DCT übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bereitstellung der Kerninfrastruktur und der grundlegenden Technologien für die Online-Dienste von Microsoft, einschließlich Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive und der Microsoft Azure-Plattform. Als Gruppe konzentriert sich CO+I auf die persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung aller Mitarbeiter und bietet Schulungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, darunter Karriere-Rotationsprogramme, Diversity & Inclusion-Schulungen und -Veranstaltungen sowie professionelle Zertifizierungen. Unsere Infrastruktur besteht aus einem großen globalen Portfolio von mehr als 200 Rechenzentren in 32 Ländern und Millionen von Servern. Unsere Stiftung basiert auf und wird von einem Team von Fachexperten verwaltet, die Dienstleistungen für mehr als 1 Milliarde Kunden und 20 Millionen Unternehmen in über 90 Ländern weltweit unterstützen. Mit ökologischer Nachhaltigkeit und Optimierung an der Spitze unseres Rechenzentrumsdesigns und -betriebs wachsen und entwickeln wir weiter, während wir die sich ständig ändernden Geschäftsanforderungen erfüllen, die Microsoft als erstklassigen Cloud-Anbieter halten. Verantwortlichkeiten
• Trägt dazu bei, das Tracking durch Eskalationen durchzuführen, Fragen zu stellen und von erfahrenen Technikern Unterstützung bei der rechtzeitigen Lösung von Problemen zu erhalten.
• Nimmt an täglichen Sicherheitseinweisungen teil, absolviert die erforderliche Schulung, die auf die Rolle und die Arbeitsbelastung ausgerichtet ist, einschließlich Sicherheitstraining, erfüllt die Sicherheitsverfahren (z. B. Verwendung von Geräten, Heben, elektrische Gefahren, Verwendung von Leitern / Rolltreppen).
• Schließt zugewiesene Tickets effizient und in Übereinstimmung mit Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) ab und erfüllt die festgelegten Service Level Agreements (SLAs) unter Anleitung anderer Techniker.
• Befolgt die Sicherheits- und Datenmanagementverfahren und -richtlinien unter Anleitung anderer Techniker und absolviert die erforderliche Sicherheitsschulung.
• Behält einen starken Kundenfokus bei, um die Auswirkungen ihrer Arbeit beim Ausfüllen von Tickets und zugewiesenen Aufgaben zu verstehen.
• Trägt zu einer positiven und effektiven Teamumgebung bei, indem es Informationen mit anderen teilt, zu regelmäßigen Teambesprechungen beiträgt, Fragen stellt und über den Status der Arbeit anderer informiert bleibt.
• Hat Stolz und ein Gefühl der Rechenschaftspflicht für die Servicequalität, Vollständigkeit und das Eigentum an den Rechenzentrumseinrichtungen.
• Verkörpert unsere Kultur und Werte. Cette occasion vous permettra de développer une compréhension de notre environnement Data Center, de vous familiariser avec les procédures de sécurité et de gestion des données, et d'accélérer votre croissance de carrière dans le processus. You will initiate warranty claims and process returns on failed equipment. This opportunity will allow you to build working knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction, and advance your career in the process.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals.
